tls.no_website: No website on the domain or on www: this check does not apply.
tls.certificate.title: Website certificate
tls.certificate.why: The certificate proves to browsers that the website is yours. Expired or invalid, it triggers the warning "Your connection is not private" and most visitors leave.
tls.certificate.ref: ANSSI, « Recommandations de sécurité relatives à TLS »
tls.certificate.expires_soon: The certificate of {host} expires in {days:day|days} ({expires_on}) and has not been renewed.
tls.certificate.renew_message:
Hello,

The HTTPS certificate of {host} expires on {expires_on}. Could you renew it before that date, preferably with automatic renewal (Let's Encrypt, for instance)?

Thank you.
tls.certificate.untrusted: Browsers do not trust the certificate of {host}: {problem}.
tls.certificate.fix_message:
Hello,

Browsers do not trust the HTTPS certificate of {host} ("{problem}"). Visitors see a security warning.

Could you install a valid certificate, with its complete chain?

Thank you.
tls.certificate.ok: Trusted certificate issued by {issuer}, valid for {days:more day|more days}.
tls.protocols.title: TLS versions
tls.protocols.why: TLS encrypts the connection. Its versions 1.0 and 1.1 have known weaknesses and browsers no longer use them: keeping them only helps attacks.
tls.protocols.ref: ANSSI, « Recommandations de sécurité relatives à TLS » · RFC 8996 (deprecation of TLS 1.0 and 1.1)
tls.protocols.message:
Hello,

The web server of {domain} still accepts {versions}, obsolete versions of TLS. Could you turn them off and keep only TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3?

Thank you.
tls.protocols.no_tls13: TLS 1.3, the safest and fastest version, is not offered.
tls.protocols.tls13_message:
Hello,

The web server of {domain} does not offer TLS 1.3. Could you turn it on, alongside TLS 1.2?

Thank you.
tls.protocols.ok: Only recent TLS versions are accepted.
tls.key.title: Certificate key
tls.key.why: A key that is too short can be broken: whoever breaks it can pose as the website.
tls.key.ref: ANSSI, « Guide de sélection d'algorithmes cryptographiques »
tls.key.weak: The certificate key of {host} is too short ({key}).
tls.key.message:
Hello,

The certificate of {host} uses a {key} key, which is too short. Could you issue a new one with an RSA key of at least 2048 bits or an ECDSA P-256 key?

Thank you.
